question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `agents.run`, `phase`, and `log` as the Code Mode Swarm API behind the existing `tools.swarm` gate?
rationale: This is a new user-facing programmable orchestration surface with persisted replay semantics, so correctness repairs alone cannot determine its long-term contract.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow gated API
options.body: Keep the existing Swarm gate, repair the event/UI model, and require live restart-safe proof before landing.

options.title: Defer the Code Mode API
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide the permanent guest API and dashboard semantics are desired.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow gated API
recommendation.body: Keep the existing Swarm gate, repair the event/UI model, and require live restart-safe proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the related feature design and the current implementation series, so they are the strongest available candidate to route the contract discussion.
